annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that any ALPN identifier that can be used with more than one protocol suite (e.g., both TLS and DTLS) is not compatible with the SvcParamKey and must not be included in the SVCB ALPN set. No alternative reasonable interpretation or missing constraint is evident.
